messages.subject: Re: Mitts
messages.text:
Hello Lawrence,
 

 At the moment, we do not manufacture a heavy-duty insulated work mitt specifically designed for intensive work use.
 

 The two adult models we currently offer are:
 

 Outdoor model – designed for colder temperatures and harsher winter conditions, with a waterproof and windproof shell.

 Urban model – softer and more flexible, ideal for everyday winter wear.

 

 Thank you again for your interest!
 __
 

 Lasclay
